title: Show the full formatted body when a mail is selected (A129)

proofs.run: read two pictures of mac-main with a mail selected (no Enter pressed): the designed (HTML) sample and the written (plain text) sample, light
proofs.pass: each shows the mail's whole body, not the one-line preview; the designed mail keeps its paper, the written one reads in the app's colours with paragraphs
selftest slice mailview: model all 22 cases pass, 17 broken answers each red on its own case

notes: Code: Sources/Features/MessageBody/MessageBodyView.swift, MessageBodyFeature.swift, MessageBodyContent.swift:124-130 (visibleParagraphs). Core: core/crates/engine/src/rust_core.rs:386-390 stored_body (reads the kept prepared form with the body: body_from_stored), tests core/crates/engine/tests/engine_body_wire.rs:125 (three fetched bodies carry the engine's result after a restart), :184 (a stored mail is read without running the engine: W3), :203; header W1-W8 lines 8-16. perf: perf/interaction.py:1-25 (33 next + 33 open moves; commit under INTERACTION_COMMIT_MS = 50 per docs/CONSTANTS.md:14), checks/realcore-perf.py:1-25 (real core with latency; last line `N checks, M failed, K not judged`; run with a bundle; it launches its own hidden copy through scripts/launch-one.sh). The 50 ms of this item is the owner's rule 'under 50 ms for any operation'. The pass line of proof 1 is the aggregate; the figures are printed only on --baseline. The mutant 1 breaks the read of the stored prepared form. Lane gap-mailview-checks: the two halves are joined in checks/realcore-check.py --slice-mailview (drive_mailview, judge_mailview): the REAL core against the local fake holds an HTML newsletter and a written mail; J selects each with no Enter, the reader's `rows mac-main.reader.body` paragraphs must hold every sentence of the mail (no raw markup), be longer than the list row's preview, and `measure mac-main.interaction.commit` right after the key must be under INTERACTION_COMMIT_MS. The body is waited for (the prefetch lands in the background); the printed line carries the seconds. Broken copy of each case: the self-test's broken answers (proof 6).
